Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Major feature: Recipe Optimizer for ClaimStake Analytics

Replaced Competitive Advantage view with new Recipe-Based ClaimStake Placement Optimizer.

Features:
- Recipe search with autocomplete
- Intelligent resource analysis (raw + processed/component materials)
- Recursive recipe expansion to find all raw materials needed
- Multi-level crafting chain detection (items craftable on single planets)
- Multi-planet cooperation detection (items requiring transport between planets)
- Regional optimization with coverage scoring and proximity analysis
- Faction filtering (MUD, ONI, UST/USTUR)
- Asteroid belt exclusion (types 3, 11, 19)
- Color-coded resources (green=raw, orange=processed/component)
- Hammer icon (🔨) indicates items craftable on specific planets
- Chain link icon (🔗) marks multi-planet cooperation items
- Scrollable planet lists showing all matches with resource tags
- Comprehensive legend and recipe requirements breakdown

Algorithm:
- Expands processed ingredients to raw materials via depth-first search
- Analyzes planets by region and faction grouping
- Calculates coverage score (% of resources available)
- Calculates proximity score (planets closer together)
- Ranks regions by overall suitability
- Detects single-planet vs multi-planet craftability
- Shows top 10 regions with detailed recommendations

UI/UX:
- Clean search interface with faction checkboxes
- Real-time filtering and optimization
- Scrollable planet widgets (max 400px height)
- Custom styled scrollbars
- Detailed resource breakdowns per planet
- Multi-planet cooperation warnings in red-bordered section
